offset_chars.description: Supplied fullwidth-character distance from the anchor lower edge.

first_line_indent.description: Indent in characters of the block's first line, where the source states it apart from the block indent.

base_text.description: Explicit witness text; empty means source-stated absence.

anchor.description: Where along the target the source located the mark. Independent of position, which is the physical side: the source states the two separately. Absent when the mark accompanies the target as a whole.

current_interpretation_facts.description: Source-owned claims for the supplied current quotation, emitted only after its target and structural constraints match.
